name: Euphoria Infotech (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in May 2001, Euphoria Infotech India Ltd is in the business of providing Information Technology Services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
EITIL is NSIC, ISO  certified, along with various other compliance certifications. The company is in the business of providing customized software development. It has developed and executed 100+ projects.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.81 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 194 days.
